target=params['target']; g=params.get('grip',-1); n=params.get('steps',35); log=[]
for k in range(n):
 o=read('robot.eef_position',0); p=o['value']; err=[target[i]-p[i] for i in range(3)]
 if max(abs(x) for x in err)<0.004: break
 a=[max(-1,min(1,x/0.05)) for x in err]+[0,0,0,g]
 act({'channel':'robot.controller_command','value':a,'duration_steps':1,'metadata':{'episode_id':o['metadata']['episode_id'],'observation_step':o['metadata']['simulator_step'],'mode':'configured_controller','units':'normalized_controller_input'}})
result=read('robot.eef_position',0)

tri.code:
c=read_capability('camera_calibration')['values']; out=[]
for sign in [1,-1]:
 rays=[]
 for name,uv in [('agentview',params['front']),('robot0_eye_in_hand',params['wrist'])]:
  t=c[name]; u,v=uv; d=[(u-64)/t['focal_pixels'][0],sign*(64-v)/t['focal_pixels'][1],-1]; r=t['rotation_camera_to_world']; rays.append((t['position_world_m'],[sum(r[i][j]*d[j] for j in range(3)) for i in range(3)]))
 p,a=rays[0]; q,b=rays[1]; w=[q[i]-p[i] for i in range(3)]; dot=lambda a,b:sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b)); aa=dot(a,a);bb=dot(b,b);ab=dot(a,b);aw=dot(a,w);bw=dot(b,w);s=(aw*bb-ab*bw)/(aa*bb-ab*ab);t=(ab*aw-aa*bw)/(aa*bb-ab*ab); A=[p[i]+s*a[i] for i in range(3)]; B=[q[i]+t*b[i] for i in range(3)];out.append({'sign':sign,'point':[(A[i]+B[i])/2 for i in range(3)],'error':sum((A[i]-B[i])**2 for i in range(3))**.5})
result=out
